summary:
The existing v3 review supplies research, not an automatic current-policy amendment. The28October incorporation plan selects bounded evaluations in existing owning issues without adopting every framework or adding all experiments to current completion dependencies. Release work maps a genuinely needed immutable candidate to standard provenance while retaining live authorization, external writer exclusion, distinct archive/payload/manifest digests and destination reconciliation. Existing revocation, conflict and interrupted-effect controls should be inspected before duplicating a retry engine or suite.

Coordination uses observed state, a bounded decision, durable intent, effect and reconciliation; delivery deduplication is distinct from business idempotency. Compare current Akka/PostgreSQL and the v3 plain-PostgreSQL-worker baseline before another engine. Delivery acknowledgements do not establish exactly-once external effects. Portable build work declares compiler/libc/linker/sysroot, dependency and environment inputs, repeats a clean build, then runs the retained artifact in its declared consumer; reproducibility does not establish ABI/native/resource acceptance.

Accessibility adapts applicable ARIA-AT expectations to a real required browser/screen-reader journey, with actual focus/dialog/menu/state announcements and separate real IME qualification. Automated checks alone are insufficient and accepted rendering is not reopened. Telemetry uses OpenTelemetry resilience as a fault-coverage benchmark for existing UTEL queues, durable receipts, corrections and restart/outage behavior; no collector-framework replacement is selected. WIT/Component Model interface and native Wasmtime fuel evaluations are separate versioned experiments, not drop-in browser ABI/fuel or deterministic host-import guarantees. Neither becomes a new current acceptance dependency.

Actual installed consumers, licensed/native journeys, independent machines and capacity remain operational evidence requirements. Existing owners/whole promises remain; source inspection or prior-art citations cannot satisfy those effects. Benefits are plausible and unmeasured.
title: Turn prior art into bounded evaluations on existing owning work
